name: Ai2
summary: Ai2 (the Allen Institute for AI) is a nonprofit research institute in Seattle, [founded in 2014 by Paul G. Allen](https://www.geekwire.com/2026/microsoft-hires-former-ai2-ceo-ali-farhadi-and-key-researchers-for-suleymans-ai-team/). It releases fully open models such as OLMo, Molmo and Tulu.
